title: Events in Portugal, by place

provenance.by: sources/events-pt/collect.mjs (code, no model; run by data.b@PrompTugal.dinis)
provenance.terms: Strictest of the sources: no reuse licence or terms page was found for any of the four hosts (teatrodasfiguras.pt and cm-tavira.pt show only "Todos os direitos reservados" in their footers, and cm-tavira.pt has no robots.txt). The robots.txt files that exist allow the paths read; agendalx.pt sets Content-Signal search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference. So: reference use only, name the source, link to the event, no AI training. Not reviewed by a person: whether this is enough to republish is for Dinis.

sources.what: Agenda Cultural de Lisboa (Câmara Municipal de Lisboa)
sources.terms: No terms page found. robots.txt (read 18 Nov 2026) allows all paths and sets "Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference": reference use with the source named and linked; no AI training.

sources.what: Câmara Municipal de Lagos, events list
sources.terms: No terms page found. robots.txt (read 18 Nov 2026) disallows only administrative folders, not /municipio/eventos.

sources.what: Teatro das Figuras, Faro (municipal theatre), agenda page
sources.terms: No terms of use page found (its information pages are directions, opening hours, privacy and cookies only). robots.txt (read 18 Nov 2026) allows all but /private/. The footer says "Todos os direitos reservados". Titles, dates and links only; each event links to its page.

sources.what: Câmara Municipal de Tavira, events (Events Calendar REST route)
sources.terms: No terms of use page found (only a privacy policy). No robots.txt (404, read 18 Nov 2026). The route is advertised in the events page head (link to /site/wp-json/tribe/events/v1/). The footer says "Todos os direitos reservados". Titles, dates, venues and organisers only; each event links to its page.

about: Events on now or starting within 60 days (to 2027-01-19) in the places listed, as schema.org Event records, each with its source URL and the time read. Dates are as the source gives them (Lisbon time; a time is added only where a single start hour is shown); a long-running event shows its first and last day. organizer is null where the source does not name an organiser (the agenda's publisher is in source). A dated record read by code, not a ticketing or booking service: check the organiser before travelling.

Not used.
